cliffCandidateDiscrepancy.conclusion: SOURCE_ENCODING_MISMATCH: the WMP-03 cliffCandidate raster encodes only 0/1 (305 candidate cells), while the U=0.5 derived sampler requires >=2. Therefore ZERO physical CLIFF blockers exist in the U=0.5 runtime. This is a measured Map-layer discrepancy, NOT an authored cliff. Applying a threshold change would mint physical blockers from CANDIDATE data without Creator/Gameplay approval, so NO geometry change is applied; it is reported as a named blocker.

terrain.note: cliffCandidate / heightClass / walkableCandidate / cargoCandidate / buildableCandidate are WMP-03 CANDIDATE rasters (8 AU analysis cells). Only CLIFF tiles (cliff>=2 && heightClass>=2) become physical blockers in the U=0.5 viewer. No Gameplay permission is minted: build/boat/swim/ferryFoot are false for every sampled tile.

roads.note: GOLD road width = 3.0 AU centreline (6 tiles at U=0.5). The verbatim LW-01 distSeg tolerance adds +0.9 AU; measured perpendicular tiles therefore exceed the nominal 6. This is the Creator-locked Beacon appearance and is NOT changed.

bridges.finding: BRIDGE_DECK_NOT_PHYSICALLY_PRESENT_IN_U05_RUNTIME. Tile priority in the derived sampler places lake/river BEFORE bridge, so every authored GOLD bridge centre renders as RIVER (code 19) and terrainBlocked()=true. The broad GOLD bridge node radius (12 AU = 24 tiles) is a diagnostic AREA, not an approved bridge span/sprite. Map must not stamp an arbitrary bridge deck; a real span/asset and Gameplay collision contract are required.

docks.finding: Docks are GOLD POINT NODES with a 10 AU diagnostic radius. Several centres are on water/coast (physically correct for a berth) and several are on dry land. No boarding/disembark cell, water depth or land path permission is authored in the U=0.5 runtime.

defects.title: All 12 GOLD bridges render as RIVER and are terrain-blocked in U=0.5 runtime
defects.owner: MAP_U05 (derived tile priority) + CREATOR (bridge span/art) + GAMEPLAY A8 (collision/permission)
defects.whyNotCorrected: The GOLD bridge node radius is 12 AU (24 tiles) — a diagnostic AREA, not an approved bridge span. Stamping it as BRIDGE would create an arbitrary ~48-tile bridge deck over the river, which REAL_MAP_CONVERSION_CONTRACT forbids ("never stamp arbitrary bridge over river") and would violate H05/H07/H08. Requires a source-backed span + approved bridge sprite/asset + Gameplay collision contract.

defects.title: Road centrelines overridden by water/cliff at river crossings
defects.owner: MAP_U05 (physical continuity) + CREATOR (where a bridge/ferry is authorised) + GAMEPLAY A8 (ferry/boat)
defects.whyNotCorrected: GOLD road centrelines and GOLD rivers are immutable source geometry. Overridden tiles are where an authored road meets authored water; changing them would reauthor GOLD or invent a crossing.

defects.title: No boarding/disembark cell or land path permission for 27 docks
defects.owner: MAP_U05 (dock geometry candidate) + GAMEPLAY A8 (boarding/vehicle) + CREATOR (art)
defects.whyNotCorrected: Docks are GOLD point nodes with a 10 AU diagnostic radius. No approved dock asset/span, water depth or land path is authored; inventing one is prohibited.

defects.title: 26 POI exterior entrance records missing
defects.whyNotCorrected: Exterior envelopes exist as GOLD foot polygons; an entrance/door is a Gameplay interaction record, not Map geometry. No fake entrance prop may be created to make a gate PASS.

defects.title: 19 buildable zones overlap POI/Elder envelopes
defects.whyNotCorrected: Legal placement after A0 protection/collision/route/resource/dynamic occupancy checks is Gameplay-owned. Map supplies candidate geometry only. U=0.5-native remeasurement is performed in the reconciliation packet, not a geometry amendment.

defects.title: Retreat polylines / vertical-link blockers / cart clearance have no Gameplay owner decision
defects.whyNotCorrected: These are semantic decisions (exit, multi-level separation, swept cart clearance), not Map geometry.

defects.title: Helicopter vs lighthouse location separation 5.6569 AU with no approved helicopter sprite
defects.whyNotCorrected: NO_RELOCATION__NO_SUBSTITUTE is a standing Creator decision.

defects.title: One GOLD POI centre is authored on a RIVER tile (terrain-blocked)
defects.owner: CREATOR / MAP_U05 (GOLD position) + GAMEPLAY A8 (POI placement)
defects.whyNotCorrected: GOLD POI positions are immutable under H04/H07 and the conversion contract. NO automatic shrink/relocate/expand. A Creator decision is required before any amendment.

defects.title: WMP-03 cliffCandidate 0/1 encoding never satisfies the U=0.5 cliff>=2 rule
defects.owner: MAP_U05 (derived sampler) + CREATOR / GAMEPLAY (cliff collision law)
defects.whyNotCorrected: Changing the threshold would mint brand-new physical blockers from 8 AU CANDIDATE cells, which is a physical-law decision, not a source-backed geometry correction. No approved cliff sprite/span or collision contract exists.

defects.title: Marine foot/boat/swim permission explicitly forbidden
defects.whyNotCorrected: WMP-04 policy forbids walkable water and unapproved boats. No permission minted.
